_note: An example ideation session, invented to show the page: no real team.

meta.title: Making onboarding less of a slog

questions.text: How might we get new starters doing real work in their first week?
How might we stop new starters drowning in accounts and passwords?

ideas.text: A starter task picked before day one.
One login checklist, owned by one person.
A buddy for the first month.
Record the welcome talk instead of repeating it.
A map of who to ask about what.

actions.what: Pick a starter task for the next two hires.
